source: synthetic: tools/make-example.mjs (forward-kinematics landmarks with 1 mm noise, processed by the HandMocap pipeline; not a camera capture)
note: Canonical hand motion for re-targeting with HandMocap or a custom importer. Not a standard mocap interchange format; use the GLB export for DCC tools and engines.

conventions.world: right-handed, +Y up, +X image-right (performer left), +Z performer->camera; from MediaPipe (x,-y,-z)
conventions.handFrame: +Y distal (wrist->middle knuckles), +Z palmar, +X = Y x Z (thumb side on right hands, little-finger side on left hands)
conventions.boneFrame: +Y along bone toward child, +Z palm normal orthogonalised to bone, +X = Y x Z; +X rotation = flexion
conventions.wrist: absolute hand-frame orientation in canonical world
conventions.joints: rest-relative local rotations in each bone canonical frame; identity = calibrated neutral open hand; composed parent->child
conventions.root: approximate camera-space position estimate (metres) used only with rootPolicy approx-screen; not an accurate trajectory
conventions.handedness: anatomical handedness of the performer; independent of preview mirroring

confidenceFields.handednessScore: MediaPipe handedness category score as returned by the API (null when not observed)
confidenceFields.stability: HEURISTIC segment-proportion consistency in [0,1]; not an API confidence
confidenceFields.observed: true when the sample came from a camera observation
confidenceFields.fingerValid: [thumb,index,middle,ring,pinky] 1 = measured this sample, 0 = held from previous
